GM and TLDR of StonkBroker drama if you aren't aware:
StonkBrokers’ Stonk Launcher (token launchpad on Robinhood Chain) briefly went live / was accessible, several tokens got deployed and traded with real on-chain activity, then the team led by SimpleFarmer framed it as testing rather than the official launch.
Here’s the rough sequence from recent reports and on-chain discussion (around August 12, 2026, UTC times):
The launcher UI showed as live / open. The factory and related contracts were deployed.
Users (including snipers) quickly created tokens. Examples mentioned include $STONKS (first one, ran up significantly, reports of ~$2M–$3M market cap range before clarification), plus others like $STONKCAT and $BROKE. Real ETH trades and liquidity happened.
One later token from a related wallet was named something like “Gated Rehearsal,” which some pointed to as evidence the team knew how to mark tests.
Community reaction: people aped in based on the live UI and on-chain activity. Some lost money when it was walked back. Critics said the team forgot (or didn’t properly enable) anti-sniper/gate protections, then called the public activity a “test” after the fact. Others noted a new factory would be deployed and that these tokens are not part of the official/special projects launch.
Source: grok

Ravencoin network hit by critical consensus vulnerability, price falls ≈20% –
Link
Ravencoin disclosed that weak nodes accepted invalid blocks starting at block height 4,487,776, exploiting a critical consensus flaw. Major mining pools 2Miners and RavenMiner are now mining an alternate chain excluding the exploited blocks.
Matters because: If the alternate chain becomes dominant, roughly three days of transaction history could be reorganized, and the official team has recommended exchanges pause deposits and withdrawals.
